title: Prescription Insurance on File: Renewal Courtesy Days on a Continuation Supply
content:
Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, a continuation supply earns renewal courtesy days according to how close to the end of the most recent approval on the coverage the most recent prior authorization request on the coverage was started.

## Rule

- When the most recent request on the coverage was started at least 1 but fewer than **7** calendar days before the approval end date of the most recent approval, **3** days are added.
- When it was started at least 7 but fewer than **14** calendar days before, **1** day is added.
- Otherwise, including a request started on or after that approval end date, no renewal courtesy is added.

## Both sides of each boundary (hypothetical: most recent approval ends 30 June)

| Most recent request started | Days before 30 June | Courtesy days |
|---|---|---|
| 30 June or later | 0 or fewer | 0 |
| 29 June | 1 | 3 |
| 24 June | 6 | 3 |
| 23 June | 7 | 1 |
| 17 June | 13 | 1 |
| 16 June | 14 | 0 |
| 1 June | 29 | 0 |

## Reading the records

The request read is the most recent prior authorization request started on the coverage, by its start date; the end date read is the approval end date of the most recent approval on the coverage.
